stories.headline: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec's religious symbols ban
body: Canada's Supreme Court left in place Quebec's ban on teachers, police and some public workers wearing religious symbols at work.
The ban covers items such as hijabs and turbans.
The court struck down a face-uncovering rule for elected members.
stories.vc: Hiring rules affect who can work in public jobs.

stories.headline: RBI merges 25 card payment rules into one framework
body: The RBI combined 25 circulars on debit, credit and prepaid cards into a single framework.
Token service providers must get annual security audits and file monthly reports.
Card issuers are told to avoid restrictive network deals.
stories.vc: Simpler rules cut compliance costs for card issuers and fintechs.

stories.headline: Karnataka wants a national portal to track substandard medicines
body: Karnataka's drugs controller called for a national portal tracking substandard medicines.
It would pool results from government and private testing labs.
Karnataka has about 53 private drug-testing labs.
stories.vc: Better data helps pull unsafe medicines from shelves faster.
